name: pi-skills
description: Skills-first Pi package with permanent Semantic-SQL memory, bioinformatics and R skills, detachable tasks, system-R RLM, and goals.

scripts.test: npm run test:background-tasks && npm run test:context-budget && npm run test:memory && npm run test:rlm && npm run test:anti-slop && npm run test:codex-web-search && npm run test:gwas-catalog-search && npm run test:open-targets-search
scripts.test:background-tasks: rm -rf .background-task-test-build && tsc --target ES2023 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --types node --rootDir . --outDir .background-task-test-build scripts/test_pi_background_tasks_patch.ts node_modules/pi-background-tasks/src/core/common.ts node_modules/pi-background-tasks/src/core/registry.ts && node .background-task-test-build/scripts/test_pi_background_tasks_patch.js; status=$?; rm -rf .background-task-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:context-budget: rm -rf .context-budget-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .context-budget-test-build --declaration false && node --test .context-budget-test-build/context-budget/context-budget.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .context-budget-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:memory: rm -rf .memory-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .memory-test-build --declaration false && cp extensions/memory/*.sql .memory-test-build/memory/ && node --test .memory-test-build/memory/memory.test.js .memory-test-build/goals/goals.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .memory-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:rlm: rm -rf .rlm-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .rlm-test-build --declaration false && node --test .rlm-test-build/rlm/rlm.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .rlm-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:codex-web-search: rm -rf .codex-web-search-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .codex-web-search-test-build --declaration false && node --test .codex-web-search-test-build/codex-web-search/codex-web-search.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .codex-web-search-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:gwas-catalog-search: rm -rf .gwas-catalog-search-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .gwas-catalog-search-test-build --declaration false && node --test .gwas-catalog-search-test-build/gwas-catalog-search/gwas-catalog-search.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .gwas-catalog-search-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:open-targets-search: rm -rf .open-targets-search-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .open-targets-search-test-build --declaration false && node --test .open-targets-search-test-build/open-targets-search/open-targets-search.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .open-targets-search-test-build; exit $status
